package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type evidenceRepositoryFake struct {
	ports.Repository
	messages     []ports.OutboxMessage
	delivered    []string
	failed       []EvidenceDeliveryFailure
	failureErr   error
	markerErrors map[string]error
}

func (repository *evidenceRepositoryFake) PendingEvidence(context.Context, int) ([]ports.OutboxMessage, error) {
	return repository.messages, nil
}
func (repository *evidenceRepositoryFake) MarkEvidenceDelivered(_ context.Context, id string, _ time.Time) error {
	if err := repository.markerErrors[id]; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	repository.delivered = append(repository.delivered, id)
	return nil
}

func (repository *evidenceRepositoryFake) MarkEvidenceFailed(_ context.Context, id string, _ time.Time, code string) error {
	repository.failed = append(repository.failed, EvidenceDeliveryFailure{MessageID: id, Code: code})
	return repository.failureErr
}

type evidencePortFake struct {
	called  []ports.PassedEvidence
	receipt ports.EvidenceReceipt
	err     error
}

func (port *evidencePortFake) ApplyPassedEvidence(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
	port.called = append(port.called, input)
	return port.receipt, port.err
}

func TestEvidenceOutboxWorkerMapsImmutablePayloadAndMarksOnlyCorrelatedReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	payload := validEvidencePayload()
	repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{{StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", SubmissionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", Payload: payload}}}
	evidence := &evidencePortFake{receipt: ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", EvidenceID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", LearningActionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: StudentReceiptPolicyV1}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: evidence, Now: func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 3, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
	count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 10)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("DispatchEvidence failed: %v", err)
	}
	if count != 1 || len(repository.delivered) != 1 || repository.delivered[0] != repository.messages[0].ID || len(evidence.called) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("outbox message was not delivered/marked exactly once: count=%d repository=%+v evidence=%+v", count, repository, evidence)
	}
	call := evidence.called[0]
	if call.EvidenceID != repository.messages[0].SubmissionID || call.SubmissionID != call.EvidenceID || call.LearningActionID != "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004" ||
		call.TaskRevisionDigest != "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb" || len(call.Evidence) != 1 ||
		len(call.Evidence[0].StepIDs) != 2 || call.Evidence[0].StepIDs[1] != "step-b" {
		t.Fatalf("immutable evidence mapping lost identity/ordered step attribution: %+v", call)
	}
}

func TestEvidenceOutboxDoesNotMarkWhenStudentReceiptDoesNotMatch(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{{StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", SubmissionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", Payload: validEvidencePayload()}}}
	evidence := &evidencePortFake{receipt: ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", EvidenceID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099", Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: StudentReceiptPolicyV1}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: evidence}
	if _, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 10); err == nil || len(repository.delivered) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("mismatched Student receipt was accepted: err=%v delivered=%v", err, repository.delivered)
	}
}

func validEvidencePayload() json.RawMessage {
	return json.RawMessage(`{"schema":"practice-task-competency-evidence.v2","evidence_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010","student_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","task_instance_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","task_revision_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003","task_revision_digest":"sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb","learning_action_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004","submission_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010","workspace_digest":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","outcome":"passed","assistance_policy_version":"practice-task-assistance-policy.v1","hints_used":0,"teacher_assistance_used":false,"evidence":[{"target":{"type":"concept","key":"go.errors","version":"v1"},"correctness":1,"independence":1,"confidence":1,"step_ids":["step-a","step-b"]}],"occurred_at":"2026-10-02T02:00:00Z","policy_version":"practice-competency-evidence-v2"}`)
}

func TestEvidenceOutboxPreservesAssignmentAcrossRepeatedDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	var wire map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(validEvidencePayload(), &wire); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire["learning_path_item_id"] = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011"
	wire["requirement_id"] = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(wire)
	repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{{StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", ID: wire["evidence_id"].(string), SubmissionID: wire["submission_id"].(string), Payload: payload}}}
	evidence := &evidencePortFake{receipt: ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", EvidenceID: wire["evidence_id"].(string), LearningActionID: wire["learning_action_id"].(string), Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: StudentReceiptPolicyV1}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: evidence}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		if _, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, call := range evidence.called {
		if call.LearningPathItemID != wire["learning_path_item_id"] || call.RequirementID != wire["requirement_id"] {
			t.Fatal("delivery lost assignment")
		}
	}
	delete(wire, "requirement_id")
	partial, _ := json.Marshal(wire)
	if _, err := DecodePassedEvidence(partial); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("partial assignment pair accepted")
	}
}

func TestCompletedFactCopiesStoredAssignmentExactly(t *testing.T) {
	wire, err := DecodePassedEvidence(validEvidencePayload())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	item, requirement := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{ID: wire.TaskInstanceID, StudentID: wire.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: wire.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: wire.TaskRevisionDigest, LearningActionID: wire.LearningActionID, LearningPathItemID: item, RequirementID: requirement, AssistancePolicyVersion: wire.AssistancePolicyVersion, Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "step-a", Status: "PASSED", Required: true, Targets: wire.Targets}}}
	submission := domain.Submission{ID: wire.SubmissionID, WorkspaceDigest: wire.WorkspaceDigest}
	payload, err := passedEvidencePayload(instance, submission, wire.OccurredAt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fact, err := DecodePassedEvidence(payload)
	if err != nil || fact.LearningPathItemID != item || fact.RequirementID != requirement {
		t.Fatalf("lost frozen assignment: %+v %v", fact, err)
	}
	instance.LearningPathItemID, instance.RequirementID = "", ""
	legacy, err := passedEvidencePayload(instance, submission, wire.OccurredAt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var fields map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(legacy, &fields)
	if _, ok := fields["learning_path_item_id"]; ok {
		t.Fatal("legacy payload changed")
	}
}

// T11 RED uses the existing ports: one poison must not hide unrelated facts.
func TestT11PoisonDoesNotStopIndependentDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	good := validEvidencePayload()
	repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{
		{StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000098", ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099", SubmissionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099", Payload: json.RawMessage(`{"schema":"poison"}`)},
		{StudentID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", SubmissionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", Payload: good},
	}}
	evidence := &evidencePortFake{receipt: ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", EvidenceID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", LearningActionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: StudentReceiptPolicyV1}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: evidence}
	count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 10)
	if count != 1 || len(repository.delivered) != 1 || err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("poison must remain an error while independent fact delivers: count=%d marked=%d err=%v", count, len(repository.delivered), err)
	}
}

type t11EvidenceFunc func(context.Context, ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error)

func (call t11EvidenceFunc) ApplyPassedEvidence(ctx context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
	return call(ctx, input)
}
func t11Message(id, student string) ports.OutboxMessage {
	var payload map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(validEvidencePayload(), &payload)
	payload["evidence_id"], payload["submission_id"], payload["student_id"] = id, id, student
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	return ports.OutboxMessage{ID: id, SubmissionID: id, StudentID: student, Payload: raw}
}
func t11Receipt(input ports.PassedEvidence) ports.EvidenceReceipt {
	return ports.EvidenceReceipt{Schema: "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", EvidenceID: input.EvidenceID, LearningActionID: input.LearningActionID, Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: StudentReceiptPolicyV1}
}
func TestT11ClassifiedFailuresContinueOnlyIndependentStudents(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range []struct{ name, code string }{
		{"payload", ports.EvidenceFailurePayloadInvalid}, {"identity", ports.EvidenceFailureIdentityMismatch},
		{"provider", ports.EvidenceFailureProviderUnavailable}, {"receipt", ports.EvidenceFailureReceiptMismatch}, {"marker", ports.EvidenceFailureDeliveryMarker},
	} {
		t.Run(scenario.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			first := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
			later := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", first.StudentID)
			other := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002")
			original := append([]byte(nil), first.Payload...)
			if scenario.name == "payload" {
				first.Payload = json.RawMessage(`{"schema":"poison"}`)
				original = append([]byte(nil), first.Payload...)
			}
			if scenario.name == "identity" {
				first.StudentID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009"
				later.StudentID = first.StudentID
			}
			repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{first, later, other}, markerErrors: map[string]error{}}
			if scenario.name == "marker" {
				repository.markerErrors[first.ID] = errors.New("private marker diagnostic")
			}
			calls := []string{}
			provider := t11EvidenceFunc(func(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
				calls = append(calls, input.EvidenceID)
				receipt := t11Receipt(input)
				if input.EvidenceID == first.ID {
					if scenario.name == "provider" {
						return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, errors.New("private provider diagnostic")
					}
					if scenario.name == "receipt" {
						receipt.PolicyVersion = "wrong"
					}
				}
				return receipt, nil
			})
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: provider}
			count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 10)
			var summary *EvidenceDispatchError
			if count != 1 || len(repository.delivered) != 1 || repository.delivered[0] != other.ID || !errors.As(err, &summary) ||
				len(summary.Failures) != 1 || summary.Failures[0].Code != scenario.code || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDependency) ||
				len(repository.failed) != 1 || repository.failed[0].Code != scenario.code || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "private") {
				t.Fatalf("incorrect recovery: count=%d err=%v failures=%+v marked=%v", count, err, repository.failed, repository.delivered)
			}
			for _, id := range calls {
				if id == later.ID {
					t.Fatal("same-student successor overtook failed head")
				}
			}
			if string(first.Payload) != string(original) {
				t.Fatal("poison fact was altered")
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT11FailurePersistenceAndContextStopDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range []string{"failure-persistence", "cancelled", "provider-cancelled"} {
		t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
			first := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
			other := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002")
			repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{first, other}}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			if scenario == "failure-persistence" {
				repository.failureErr = domain.ErrConflict
				first.Payload = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
				repository.messages[0] = first
			}
			if scenario == "cancelled" {
				cancel()
			}
			calls := 0
			provider := t11EvidenceFunc(func(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
				calls++
				if scenario == "provider-cancelled" {
					cancel()
					return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, context.Canceled
				}
				return t11Receipt(input), nil
			})
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: provider}
			count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(ctx, 10)
			if count != 0 || err == nil || len(repository.delivered) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("dispatch did not stop: %d %v", count, err)
			}
			if scenario == "failure-persistence" && (calls != 0 || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict)) {
				t.Fatal("unpersisted failure allowed progress")
			}
			if scenario != "failure-persistence" && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Fatal("cancellation lost")
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT11ReceiptRequiresEveryExactAcceptedField(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []string{"schema", "accepted", "evidence", "action", "policy"} {
		t.Run(field, func(t *testing.T) {
			message := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
			repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{message}}
			provider := t11EvidenceFunc(func(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
				receipt := t11Receipt(input)
				switch field {
				case "schema":
					receipt.Schema = "wrong"
				case "accepted":
					receipt.Accepted = false
				case "evidence":
					receipt.EvidenceID = "wrong"
				case "action":
					receipt.LearningActionID = "wrong"
				case "policy":
					receipt.PolicyVersion = "wrong"
				}
				return receipt, nil
			})
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: provider}
			if count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 1); count != 0 || err == nil || len(repository.failed) != 1 || len(repository.delivered) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("invalid receipt acknowledged")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestT11LocalTimeoutDoesNotStopIndependentDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range []string{"provider", "marker"} {
		t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
			first := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
			other := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002")
			repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{first, other}, markerErrors: map[string]error{}}
			if scenario == "marker" {
				repository.markerErrors[first.ID] = context.DeadlineExceeded
			}
			provider := t11EvidenceFunc(func(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
				if scenario == "provider" && input.EvidenceID == first.ID {
					return ports.EvidenceReceipt{}, context.DeadlineExceeded
				}
				return t11Receipt(input), nil
			})
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: provider}
			count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(context.Background(), 10)
			if count != 1 || err == nil || len(repository.failed) != 1 || len(repository.delivered) != 1 || repository.delivered[0] != other.ID {
				t.Fatalf("local timeout stopped independent fact: count=%d err=%v", count, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestT11CancelledContextCannotAcknowledgeProviderReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	message := t11Message("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
	repository := &evidenceRepositoryFake{messages: []ports.OutboxMessage{message}}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	provider := t11EvidenceFunc(func(_ context.Context, input ports.PassedEvidence) (ports.EvidenceReceipt, error) {
		cancel()
		return t11Receipt(input), nil
	})
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Evidence: provider}
	count, err := runtime.DispatchEvidence(ctx, 1)
	if count != 0 || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || len(repository.failed) != 0 || len(repository.delivered) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("cancelled dispatch attempted persistence")
	}
}
